text: @realDonaldTrump We raised this with the prior administration and nothing happened. Just want a fair outcome, ideally where tariffs/rules are equally moderate. Nothing more. Hope this does not seem unreasonable.

text: @realDonaldTrump I am against import duties in general, but the current rules make things very difficult. It’s like competing in an Olympic race wearing lead shoes.
